title: Incorporating argumentation frameworks for LLM decision-making: Task-specific design and evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Argumentation frameworks (AFs) provide explicit, formal mechanisms for representing and resolving conflicts and thus have been incorporated into large language model (LLM) decision-making. The benefits vary and depend on how arguments and their relations are constructed, evaluated, and incorporated into the decision process. {We abstract a workflow consisting of four stages based on existing argumentation-augmented methods} and investigate their design choices over tasks of debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification. Our evaluation with recent LLMs shows that existing methods do not consistently improve performance across the considered tasks. Motivated by this observation, we develop two task-specific methods. The first is called Qnt-Arg, which organizes arguments around the original speakers in debate materials and aggregates model-estimated argument strengths and candidate-answer priors under gradual semantic

translated_title: 将论证框架融入大语言模型决策：面向特定任务的设计与评估
translated_abstract: 论证框架提供了显式的、形式化的机制来表示和化解冲突，因此已被应用于大语言模型的决策中。其收益各不相同，取决于论据及其关系如何被构建、评估以及如何融入决策过程。我们基于现有的论证增强方法抽象出一个包含四个阶段的工作流程，并在基于辩论的决策任务和基于检索的事实核查任务上研究其设计选择。我们使用近期的大语言模型进行评估，结果显示现有方法在所考虑的任务中并不能一致地提升性能。基于这一观察，我们开发了两种面向特定任务的方法。第一种称为Qnt-Arg，它围绕辩论材料中的原始发言者来组织论据，并在渐进语义下聚合模型估计的论据强度和候选答案先验……
tldr: 本文抽象出四阶段的论证增强工作流程，发现现有方法在不同任务上提升不一致，并据此提出了Qnt-Arg等两种面向特定任务的方法，以改进LLM在辩论决策与事实核查中的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper abstracts a four-stage argumentation-augmented workflow, shows that existing methods inconsistently improve LLM decision-making across tasks, and proposes two task-specific methods such as Qnt-Arg for debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification.
